label: NAR, from the root's withholding of each grounded being, bridge (b2) and the common root
description: Argument N1, the derivation of NAR asked by #1944's gap 1. Not a transcription: neither premise's consequent is NAR. It uses NAR's general form (over all actual concreta), which is no harder to derive here than the holder-restricted form, so the restriction is not registered. Establishes no premise. Shared dependency: under (b2), factive giving, a common root, necessary roots and excluded middle, its premise (a) restates NAR (controls, law 3); it adds warrant for NAR only through support for (a) (N2, N3, neither of which restates NAR). Premise choice: the weakest common-root premise is a6b46d2e (ActualCommonRootAt), and the Solution proves N1 from it (nar_of_commonRoot); the registered argument uses 0c27f65a, whose root and reach clauses are exactly a6b46d2e, because a6b46d2e's legacy definition links carry several senses of four terms and would make any new argument using it an unbridged sense mixing (a #216 cleanup). The God-naming and intellect clauses of 0c27f65a are unused. Omission models: without (b2) (#1944's necessary-through-another model, whose root gives nothing), without (a) (the mixed-mode root), without the common root (mutual grounding, where 0c27f65a fails).
